**Severity:** warning · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
Keyed state `signal()` is created inside a loop: the browser pairs a site's repeated creations with the server's by order, so a loop that runs a different number of times in the adopt run adopts the wrong values; give each iteration its own component (a `<For>` row) or create the state once outside the loop
```

```text
Keyed state `createStore()` is created inside a loop: the browser pairs a site's repeated creations with the server's by order, so a loop that runs a different number of times in the adopt run adopts the wrong values; give each iteration its own component (a `<For>` row) or create the state once outside the loop
```

## How to fix

Give each iteration its own component (render a `<For>` row / child component that creates its state) or create one `signal()` / `createStore()` outside the loop holding the list (`const picked = signal(props.items.map(() => false))`).

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { signal } from "@rivetjs/reactivity";
export function Checks(props) {
  const picked = [];
  for (const item of props.items) picked.push(signal(false));
  return <ul>{props.items.map((item, i) => <li onClick={() => picked[i].set(true)}>{item}</li>)}</ul>;
}
```

```tsx prefer
import { signal } from "@rivetjs/reactivity";
export function Checks(props) {
  const picked = signal(props.items.map(() => false));
  return <ul>{props.items.map((item, i) => <li onClick={() => picked.set(picked().with(i, true))}>{item}</li>)}</ul>;
}
```

## When it is reported

Derived resume model only (`resume: { model: "derived" }`, plan M2 C2). Every `signal(x)` / `createStore(x)` call of a resume module compiles to a keyed registration (`_rSig(key, x)`: key = module prefix + source-order site ordinal); the server ships the values per boundary and the adopt run reads them by key. Keys are per site, so state created under an `if` / `?:` / `&&` / `switch` / `try` is fine (a render that skips it skips its key; M2-R5 2026-10-20 narrowed the warning to loops). A site that registers more than once in a boundary gets an occurrence suffix (`#2`, `#3`, …): those pair by order, which a loop makes depend on the iteration count. Warning: the module compiles.
